test_title: PYST 49: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing ‘1’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0434385fd18332fda300c3145c78cb8c4a973cbee71068321173922526fa0878.png]
solution:
From figure 1 and 2 of the same dice,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0434385fd18332fda300c3145c78cb8c4a973cbee71068321173922526fa0878.png] 

→ **Faces numbered 5 and 4 are common **⇒ **Face numbered 1 is opposite to face numbered 6.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"6".**
